name: Stage 4 Preview Handoff Contract
purpose: Define a dry-run, preview-only, non-mutating envelope for handing a validated SEMASCRIPT action document to a GPTMEAi planner preview review boundary.

normalized_action_document_representatio.description: Validation-friendly canonical SEMASCRIPT action document representation produced before any GPTMEAi planner preview handoff.

gptmeai_planner_preview_handoff_object.description: Preview handoff envelope referencing the existing GPTMEAi planner preview contract without invoking GPTMEAi execution.

approval_gate_result.description: Local approval gate result required before any future execution-enabled work.

validation_normalization_diagnostics.description: Non-mutating diagnostics from validation and normalization.

validation_stages.description: Validate the SEMASCRIPT action document against existing v0.1 manual and contract rules.
Normalize the action document into the canonical representation used for preview mapping.
Build the planner preview handoff envelope from existing preview-only mapping semantics.
Stop at the approval gate and do not call GPTMEAi execution, dispatch, storage, memory, ledger, or runtime mutation paths.

approval_gates.approval_effect: Approval may confirm review of the handoff envelope but does not enable execution.
approval_gates.denial_effect: Denied approval returns a non-mutating outcome and stops the handoff.

rollback_plan.strategy: Remove this contract draft and its focused guard test.
